title: Project Guage 0.5 (2 GAME BUNDLE)

body.intro:
Project Guage is an atmospheric survival horror game in EARLY ACCESS.

Check out my Ci-en for more information

*BUG FIXES AND OTHER CONTENT ADDED*

*Extended Demo Added*

Major AI Overhaul
The AI’s "pursuit and patrol" behaviors, which were previously hard-coded, have been replaced with a "behavior tree" system. This has led to a dramatic improvement in the overall gameplay experience. While the AI ​​is now more formidable—making the game more challenging during playtesting—it also makes for a more engaging and enjoyable experience.

Ragdoll Fixes
Fixed a bug that caused characters' heads to detach upon death.

Mini-game Upgrades
While the new mode is technically ready, I want to ensure the map is perfectly polished before its official release. In the meantime, I have added 5 rounds to the existing mini-game mode, making it more engaging and intense.


Exceptional Unreal Engine 5 Optimization We believe that 3D works should be accessible. Built on Unreal Engine 5, Project Guage is heavily optimized to run exceptionally efficiently on a wide variety of hardware, making it incredibly friendly for older NVIDIA GTX setups and integrated graphics

DirectX 12 Required: Ensure your PC supports DX12.

Low Settings: Smooth performance utilizing only 4GB VRAM.

High / Epic Settings: Full visual fidelity utilizing only 5GB to 6GB VRAM.

introductions.title: Integration of "She Just Can't Stop Masturbating"!

body.intro: A button to the BONUS GAME has been added to the bottom-right corner of the main menu and you can alternate between games easily from both main menus more info can be found on my ci-en with videos etc.

Ammunition Drops and Reloading
Ammo can now be found throughout the main game. In the mini-games, your ammunition is fully replenished at the start of each round. Additionally, the number of magazines you currently have in your possession is now displayed just above the "Panty Widget" on the screen.

Hair Simulation
A toggle for hair simulation has been added (set to "off" by default).

Two New Enemies
Two new types of enemies have been added to both the main game and the mini-game mode.

This version introduces a new gunplay system!
You can now stagger "Stalker"-type enemies by hitting them with a certain amount of gunfire. We have also increased the number of enemy spawn points in the game's linear progression areas. Adjustments and updates have been made to the mini-game as well.

Round based survival has been added !!

The goal is to stay alive, manage your condition, progress through each round.

Safe zones are special areas marked by a distinct blue light. These zones provide guaranteed safety from enemies and recovery opportunities, such as changing into fresh clothing

Hide behind objects to avoid enemy detection and use cover to break line of sight if combat isn't an option
A new sandbox zone has been added with various option's to pick from!!

The Panty Widget serves as a direct, real-time reflection of the main character’s physical and psychological status. Far from a simple cosmetic tracker, this interface element plays a central role in how you navigate the nightmare. Every encounter, injury, and spike in terror shifts the widget's state, dictating core survival horror mechanics.
